notes.title: Dirty Room Chapter 7 and 8 released
notes.notes:
Chapter 7

You contacted the black-suited soldier and knew that his team is fighting with a large number of zombies in an old city, where Dr. Q is located. You realized that the situation is worse than expected after arriving......

Chapter 8

You start investigating the old city and try to find out where is Dr. Q hiding. The city looks safe but you still have a very uneasy feeling......

***Achievement of chapter 7 and 8 will be added along with chapter 9***
